import os,json,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='partial-managed-',dir='.cache')).resolve()/'flow'
subprocess.run(['python3','tests/rust_native_partial_validation.py','--binary',os.environ['SWARM_STATUS_CONTRACT_BINARY'],'--profile',os.environ['SWARM_STATUS_CONTRACT_PROFILE'],'--output',str(p)],check=True)
r=json.loads((p/'result.json').read_text());assert r['status']=='PASS' and not r['task_accepted'] and not r['reexecuted'] and r['ordinary']==False and len(r['checks'])==9
print('PARTIAL_MANAGED_RECIPE_PASS '+str(p))

r=json.loads((p/'result.json').read_text());assert r['status']=='PASS' and not r['task_accepted'] and not r['reexecuted'] and r['ordinary']==True and len(r['checks'])==8
